answer: One concrete Sybil defense is collateral-backed identity. Each agent registers a single signing quill, a key bound to stake locked in a shared vault. Payout on the reputation mesa is proportional to verified work, not the number of identities. To win with Sybil, an attacker must lock the full stake for every fake quill, and any detected forgery slashes the whole vault, so the cost grows linearly with each fake identity while an honest agent pays only once.
